description: The file defines the BackupService class, a lifecycle-aware Android foreground service responsible for backing up and restoring notes, managing notifications during these processes, and interfacing with backup and preference management components.

classes.name: BackupService
classes.description: An Android foreground service managing backup and restore operations for notes, including notification handling and background job management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager when the service is created.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to trigger backup or restore actions based on specified extras.

methods.name: onTimeout
methods.description: Cancels ongoing jobs and stops the service if timeout occurs.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing coroutines when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: startJob
methods.description: Starts a background coroutine job with provided suspend block, managing completion and cleanup.

methods.name: backupNotes
methods.description: Performs backup of notes to a specified URI, displaying progress notifications.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores notes from a specified URI, managing notifications during the process.
